prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headache beginning shortly after the event. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force involved in the impact is in keeping with a cervical strain. Over five visits the patient received manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical course, with pain scores and functional limitations improving steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as recovery progressed. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion were documented and support the reported injury. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation, was within normal limits. Records also show a remote soft-tissue strain to the same region that resolved completely without lasting deficit. Billing entries for similar services on the same day are under review. Current status: improving, with discharge from active care anticipated once the home program is independently maintained.
